scope: Seven UI follow-ups: settings, logout, desktop/mobile game controls, preview divider/audio, Enter submission and immediate elapsed time.

backend.command: DATABASE_URL=postgresql:///gameforge_ui_followup_20261026 TZ=UTC .venv/bin/pytest studio/tests/test_domain.py -m 'not browser and not live'

preview_audio.evidence: Native Web Audio and HTML media in opaque iframe; existing/future sources, author mute, clock continuity, invalid-source/hash messages, exact raw export preserved.

regressions_prevented: Late session and preference responses after logout cannot revive an account or replace accepted CSRF.
A first submission keeps its ownership across asynchronous route navigation and enables cancellation on HTTP acknowledgement.
Hidden preview audio is muted without destroying the iframe or restarting game state.
Optimistic message and timer reconcile with saved messages without duplication or resetting the initial seconds.
limitations: Browser UI uses controlled HTTP fixtures and a synthetic game with native audio.
No real model calls, physical iOS/Android, Safari or deployment.
Backend coverage is the targeted domain suite, not a repeat of the entire repository suite.
